import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.index_C_mul
#check @MvPolynomial.support_smul_eq
#check @Finsupp.support_smul_eq
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul
#check_failure AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_smul
#check_failure AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree_smul
namespace IndexCMulMathlib147
universe u v w z
theorem modern {A : Type u} {R : Type v} {S : Type w} {T : Type z}
    [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [IsDomain S] [Module S R] [Module.IsTorsionFree S R]
    [SemilatticeInf T] [OrderTop T] (D : A → T) {c : S} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D (c • f) = AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D f := by
  classical
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul,
    Finsupp.support_smul_eq hc]
theorem supportGeneral {A : Type u} {M : Type v} {S : Type w}
    [Semiring S] [IsDomain S] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module S M]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree S M] {c : S} (hc : c ≠ 0) (f : A →₀ M) :
    (c • f).support = f.support := Finsupp.support_smul_eq hc
#print axioms modern
#print axioms supportGeneral
end IndexCMulMathlib147
